title: FairFuzz: Targeting Rare Branches to Rapidly Increase Greybox Fuzz Testing Coverage
evidence_note: 9 benchmarks; each fuzzer×benchmark 24h single-core runs repeated 20 times; target-dependent coverage; only 25% FairFuzz c++filt runs found crashes vs 85–100% comparators; branch-mask target hit rate is a mechanism metric, not crash yield.

title: Deep Bayesian Active Learning for Natural Language Processing: Results of a Large-Scale Empirical Study
evidence_note: Three task families with two datasets each; 2% warm start and 2% increments up to 50%; 3 warm-start runs per configuration; positive AL-over-IID results and usually positive disagreement-over-classic-uncertainty results, with selected-task/model limits.

title: iFogSim: A Toolkit for Modeling and Simulation of Resource Management Techniques in Internet of Things, Edge and Fog Computing Environments
sections_checked: §§5–6 two simulated applications and cloud/edge placement outcomes
evidence_note: Edge-ward placement lowers modeled latency/network/cloud energy and slightly increases edge-device energy; case-study topology/workload values are modeled, not production trace validation.

title: AI Safety Gridworlds
evidence_note: 20 seeds trained per agent/environment with the worst-performing 25% removed for variance reduction; safety reward/performance mismatch demonstrated in toy gridworlds; authors explicitly call for more realistic environments and state a test suite cannot prove safety absence.

title: YAFS: A simulator for IoT scenarios in fog computing
evidence_note: Independent simulator comparison of iFogSim EEG-game placement; numerical results differ under similar settings with stated unit/link/event semantics; dynamic scenarios lack real traces and use arbitrary parameters.

title: Evaluation Metrics for Safe Reinforcement Learning
evidence_note: Four tasks×three safety bounds×four algorithms×30 seeds; reports mean cost, violation frequency/magnitude, IQM, training noisy vs final greedy; limited to four tasks and algorithms permitting training violations.
